comparison.objective: Seal, shake, mix, reopen, and safely leave a cocktail shaker without spilling.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sealing, load sharing, vigorous axial agitation, opening, and upright replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Drink mixed after qualified shaking, spill below limit, shaker reopened and upright; seal loss or excessive spill fails.
comparison.reason: This is the closest motion-level analogue, but its tested ability is sealed-vessel mixing and seal management. The candidate tests physical size selection through apertures, simultaneous washer retention, receiver recovery, and screen reseating.
